findings.exact_source_change: artifact_records resolves build_dir then source_root once per map, and calls renamed private _locate_under_resolved_roots. The helper still resolves each artifact freshly, chooses build before source, checks relative.parts/no dotdot and rejects outside roots. Receipt root/path/bytes/SHA256 fields and hashing are unchanged.
findings.map_lifetime: Roots are local variables for one artifact_records invocation; no global/lru or cross-map/pre-post cache exists. verify_execution_inputs still reparses artifact selectors and recomputes all three maps after CTest, then checks copies, inventory and source identity.
findings.containment: Canonical artifact symlinks must remain within the canonical build or source root. Build-first precedence for nested/equal roots and root-itself rejection remain unchanged. resolve_record and consumed-copy escaping-symlink checks are byte/AST unchanged. No lexical containment substitute or resolved-artifact reuse was introduced.
findings.eager_error_compatibility: Both roots now resolve before the sorted artifact loop, including empty maps and maps wholly inside build. Previously source resolution was lazy and an unused invalid/looping/inaccessible source root could escape evaluation. This is an earlier rejection outside actual supported callers, which already resolve both roots and require source identity; no blocker found. Filesystem roots are snapshots for a map, not an atomic filesystem transaction or promise of safety under arbitrary concurrent root retargeting.
findings.helper_rename: Only artifact_records calls the renamed private helper. Bounded scripts/tests/cmake/.github search found no other old-helper consumer. CLI is unchanged; no promise is made for unknown external code importing this implementation helper.
findings.fixtures_and_limits: Every other top-level AST node is identical, including all fixture/negative controls, persistent-output child logic and its10/15s bounds, main/parser options, and existing pre/post verification. tests/CMakeLists.txt still registers OperationalBuildGate.ReleaseInstallRequiresExactPassedEstate with Mandatory;Operational labels and TIMEOUT10; no deadline/assertion/input change.
findings.mechanical_checks: Original equals current tracked source and exact HEAD Git blob; patch exactly reconstructed with stdlib difflib; both source files parsed via builtin AST only; unchanged top-level AST equality excluding the two modified functions confirmed.

limits.conclusion: No source blocker found for valid stable roots in existing callers. Root still needs actual relevant validation after integration; this review establishes neither the previous10s timeout cause nor that the candidate meets it.
